name: deploy-deck
description: Live deploy tracker for GitHub Actions and Deployments, Vercel, Cloudflare Pages and Workers, and Render: a stage pipeline above the prompt, a /deploys panel, toasts and a status line. Read-only.

githubToken.title: GitHub token
githubToken.description: Read-only token (fine-grained: Actions read, Deployments read, Metadata read). Empty: the logged-in gh CLI is used.

vercelToken.title: Vercel token
vercelToken.description: A Vercel access token scoped to the team that owns the project. deploy-deck only sends GET requests with it.

vercelTeamId.title: Vercel team id
vercelTeamId.description: team_… of the team that owns the project. Empty: taken from .vercel/project.json (orgId) when it is a team.

cloudflareToken.title: Cloudflare API token
cloudflareToken.description: Account API token with Cloudflare Pages: Read and Workers Scripts: Read.

cloudflareAccountId.title: Cloudflare account id
cloudflareAccountId.description: The account the Pages project or Worker lives in. Empty: taken from account_id in wrangler.toml / wrangler.jsonc.

renderToken.title: Render API key
renderToken.description: Render API key (Account settings → API keys). deploy-deck only sends GET requests with it.

targets.title: Extra targets
targets.description: Comma-separated targets to track beside the detected ones, e.g. vercel:my-app, cloudflare-pages:site, cloudflare-workers:api, render:srv-123, github:owner/repo.

autoDetect.title: Detect targets from the repo
autoDetect.description: Read the git remote, .vercel/project.json, vercel.json, wrangler.toml/jsonc and render.yaml.

useCli.title: Fall back to the gh CLI
useCli.description: Without a GitHub token, read GitHub through `gh api` (read-only GETs) when gh is logged in.

fastSeconds.title: Poll interval while deploying (seconds)
fastSeconds.description: How often targets are read while any deploy is in flight.

slowSeconds.title: Poll interval when idle (seconds)
slowSeconds.description: How often targets are read while nothing is in flight.

band.title: Band above the prompt
band.description: Show in-flight deploys with their stage pipeline above the prompt.

toasts.title: Toast when a deploy finishes
toasts.description: One toast per deploy when it goes live or fails.

statusLine.title: Status line
statusLine.description: Show the most important current deploy under the prompt (e.g. '🚀 vercel building 1:12').
